product_one_liner.value: Luminance is an AI-powered contract intelligence platform that helps enterprise legal, procurement, finance and sales teams review and negotiate contracts, automate workflows and uncover risks, obligations and commercial opportunities.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the homepage navigation or footer; the /pricing URL did not return a pricing page, and the site directs buyers to request a demo.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts by Luc Frachon and the Luminance Evals Team, and by co-founder/Director of AI Dr Graham Sills, explain model evaluation and the platform’s AI architecture.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation offers three versions and covers multiple API resources; this is distinct from the customer-only Support Hub.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Machine Learning Research Engineer, Cambridge, United Kingdom; the posting provides the role description and requirements.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Luminance’s proprietary Luna Crescent legal intelligence model.
model_provider.notes: The subprocessors page identifies OpenAI API processing for additional generative-model features; it separately lists AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud as in-cloud model-processing infrastructure. Model use varies by feature and customer configuration.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page claims ISO 27001 certification and regular SOC 2 Type II examinations; SOC 2 is an assurance examination rather than a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest documented round was announced on 2025-02-18, before the 2025-05-09–2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Business Development Representative, London, United Kingdom.

launched_6mo.notes: Luna Crescent, the proprietary legal intelligence model, was announced on 2026-06-19, within the 2026-05-09–2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Don Riddick was appointed Chief Legal Officer on 2026-09-29, within the 2025-11-09–2026-11-09 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot is explicitly used for website visitor tracking, form submissions and contact deduplication. Salesforce is a documented CRM integration; that establishes an integration signal, not proof that Luminance uses it as its own internal CRM.
